pose_en: Side view of one woman standing upright beside a sturdy chair, one hand holding the top of the chair backrest for support, trunk still and upright. She stands on the leg closest to the chair; the outer leg hangs relaxed and straight, just off the floor. One large solid black curved double-headed arrow in front of and behind the free foot, following an arc forward and backward, showing the leg swinging loosely forward and back like a pendulum. NOT lying down, NOT on a bench, NOT a sideways leg swing.

Side view of one woman kneeling on an exercise mat, knees hip-width apart, holding the two handles of a small ab wheel (a single wheel with a handle on each side) with both hands on the floor directly under her shoulders, arms straight, back straight and neutral, head in line with the spine. One large solid black straight arrow starts at the wheel and points forward along the floor, away from the knees, showing the wheel rolling forward. NOT lying on the back, NOT a crunch frame or machine.

Front view of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart, a long straight stick resting horizontally across the back of her shoulders behind the neck, both hands holding the stick near its ends, elbows bent, stick level. Hips and feet face straight forward. One large solid black curved arrow sweeps horizontally around the front of the chest at shoulder height, showing the upper body rotating to one side while the hips stay facing forward. NOT a diagonal stick, NOT a side bend.

Side view of one woman lying on her back on an exercise mat, knees bent with feet flat, arms relaxed beside the body, the back of her head resting on a small flat pillow, face looking straight up at the ceiling. One short solid black curved arrow starts just in front of the forehead and curves up and toward the chest, showing the chin tucking toward the chest and the head lifting a small distance off the pillow. Shoulders stay on the mat.

Strict side view, the chair seen from the side. Static balance stance: one woman stands upright directly BEHIND a simple sturdy chair, facing the chair backrest, both hands resting lightly on the top of the backrest in front of her. Her feet are in ONE straight line pointing forward: the front foot is placed directly in front of the back foot so the HEEL of the front foot touches the TOES of the back foot (heel-to-toe tandem stance, like standing on a tightrope); both feet fully visible, one clearly in front of the other, no gap. Trunk upright, looking forward. There is NO arrow anywhere in the image. NOT feet side by side, NOT a split or lunge stance.
pose_en_r1: Side view. Static balance stance: one woman stands upright directly behind a simple sturdy chair, both hands resting lightly on the top of the chair backrest. Her feet are placed in one straight line, one foot directly in front of the other so that the heel of the front foot touches the toes of the back foot (heel-to-toe tandem stance). Trunk upright, looking forward. There is NO arrow anywhere in the image. Feet clearly heel to toe, NOT a split or lunge stance.

pose_en: Three-quarter front view of one woman standing upright with feet hip-width apart next to a kitchen counter (or sturdy table) at her side, one hand resting lightly on the edge of the counter, the other arm relaxed. One large solid black curved arrow drawn on the floor around her feet as an almost full circle, showing her turning around on the spot with small steps. Only one hand touches the counter; the counter is beside her, NOT a chair in front of her.

Side view of one woman sitting upright on the front part of a chair, feet flat on the floor and placed slightly back under the knees, weight even over both feet. A sturdy table stands directly in front of her; both hands rest flat on the table top. One large solid black curved arrow starts at the hips and curves forward and up, showing the trunk leaning forward and the body rising to standing. The table in front of her must be clearly visible.

Strict side view (profile) of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart. One arm is stretched straight FORWARD from the shoulder at eye level, elbow straight, fist closed with the thumb pointing up, the thumb at arm's length directly in front of her eyes; she looks at the thumb. The other arm hangs relaxed. One short solid black curved double-headed arrow just above the top of the head, showing the head turning slowly left and right while the thumb stays still. The arm points straight forward at arm's length, NOT bent, NOT across the face, NOT to the side.
pose_en_r1: Three-quarter front view of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart. One arm is stretched straight forward in front of her face at eye level with the thumb pointing up, the thumb directly in front of her nose; her eyes look at the thumb. The other arm hangs relaxed. One short solid black curved double-headed arrow just above the head, from side to side, showing the head turning slowly left and right while the thumb stays still in front. The arm points straight FORWARD, NOT out to the side.

pose_en: Side view of one woman kneeling upright on an exercise mat behind a large exercise ball, both knees on the mat, hips above the knees. Her FOREARMS rest flat on top of the ball from elbow to wrist, elbows bent at about 90 degrees, hands pressed together with palms touching. One large solid black straight arrow starts at the ball and points forward along the floor, showing the ball rolling forward while the knees stay on the mat. Forearms on the ball, NOT straight arms, NOT only hands on the ball, NOT on the toes.
pose_en_r1: Side view of one woman kneeling upright on an exercise mat behind a large exercise ball, both knees on the mat, hips above the knees, forearms resting on top of the ball with the hands pressed together. One large solid black straight arrow starts at the ball and points forward along the floor, showing the ball rolling forward while the knees stay on the mat. Knees stay on the mat, NOT on the toes, NOT a plank.

pose_en: Side view of one woman lying on her side on an exercise mat with a foam roller under the outer side of her lower hip (side of the buttock), the roller lying perpendicular to the body. She props herself up on the lower forearm, the upper hand on the floor in front of her for support; the lower leg is straight, the upper leg bent with the foot on the floor in front of the lower leg. One short solid black double-headed arrow along the side of the hip, showing her rolling slightly back and forth over the side of the buttock. NOT sitting, NOT a figure-four position.

Side view of one woman sitting upright on the front part of a chair (not touching the backrest), feet flat on the floor, both arms stretched straight forward in front of her at shoulder height. One large solid black curved arrow behind the upper back, pointing backward, showing the trunk leaning back a small way under control. Arms stretched FORWARD, NOT hands behind the head.

Front view of one woman standing upright behind a simple chair, facing the chair backrest, both hands holding the top of the backrest. In this STARTING position BOTH feet stand on the floor side by side, hip-width apart, legs straight, trunk still. One large solid black curved arrow starts at the outer ankle of one foot and curves straight out to the side and slightly up, showing that straight leg will lift sideways (abduction). Both feet on the floor in the image; the leg is NOT yet lifted, NOT moved backward or diagonally.
pose_en_r1: Front view of one woman standing upright behind a simple chair, facing the chair, both hands holding the top of the backrest. Both feet on the floor, trunk still. One large solid black curved arrow starts at the outer ankle of one leg and curves straight out to the side, showing the straight leg lifting sideways (abduction). The leg moves purely to the SIDE, NOT backward or diagonally.
